name: qveris
title: QVeris
description: Discover, inspect, and safely run capabilities from the QVeris network.
author: dev_qveris

commands.name: discover-capabilities
commands.title: Discover Capabilities
commands.description: Find and inspect tools available through QVeris

tools.name: discover-capabilities
tools.title: Discover Capabilities
tools.description: Find ranked QVeris capabilities for a task using a natural-language query. Discovery is free and returns tool IDs, parameter hints, reliability, and pricing metadata.

tools.name: inspect-capability
tools.title: Inspect Capability
tools.description: Get the current schema, examples, reliability, and pricing metadata for a QVeris capability ID. Inspection is free.

tools.name: probe-capability
tools.title: Probe Capability
tools.description: Validate parameters and request a free pre-call quote for a QVeris capability without executing it.

tools.name: call-capability
tools.title: Call Capability
tools.description: Execute a QVeris capability selected from a prior discovery. The extension validates parameters and shows a confirmation with the available cost estimate before execution.

ai.instructions: Use Discover before Inspect or Call. Preserve tool_id and search_id exactly as returned. Inspect the selected capability and build parameters only from its current schema. Probe before calling whenever parameters or cost are uncertain. Never invent a tool ID or parameter. Capability calls can consume QVeris credits and may have third-party side effects; rely on the confirmation shown by the extension.

preferences.name: apiKey
preferences.title: QVeris API Key
preferences.description: API key used only to authenticate requests to the selected QVeris API region.

preferences.name: apiRegion
preferences.title: API Region
preferences.description: Choose the QVeris service where your API key was created.
